claims.statement: For the finite asymmetric rooted branch-forest family generated by the C2-F3 script, with 3<=p<=7 and |T|=2p+2, every eligible generated tree has a nonpositive complete favorable-leaf sum and no positive selected summand.
claims.scope: Only the specified rooted family: support-rooted trees with a distinguished support-leaf, total branch order 2p, at least two branch components and at least two distinct rooted component types, under the exact primary eligibility guards. This is bounded computation, not the full first-shell assertion.
claims.reason: retained: local-copy replay exactly reproduces the pinned result JSON; generation, strict selector, terminal descent, both eligibility guards, original deletions, per-leaf multiplicity, and complete sums match the stated finite scope. The calculation has no reach beyond this family and these five p values.

limitations: The replay covers only the generated asymmetric rooted branch-forest family at p=3 through 7, not every ordinary tree in the first shell.
Symmetric branch multisets, families with fewer than two branches or one distinct branch type, and p outside 3 through 7 are omitted.
No theorem or counterexample for the full registered first-shell assertion follows from these bounded computations.
